title: Spicy Indian Beef Kachori
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired snack filled with spiced ground beef, served with a side of chutney.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
3. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
5. Add the chopped cilantro, lime juice, salt, black pepper, and garam masala, and stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the filling for 10-15 minutes.
7. Meanwhile, preheat oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F.
8. When the oil is hot, add a few kachoris to the oil and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
9. Remove the kachoris from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
10. Stuff each kachori with the spiced ground beef and serve hot with a side of chutney.
